comparison.objective: Candidate tunes and locks a rigid industrial damper; pr-1694 rolls puff pastry to a target length and thickness without damaging its ends.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses a hex key, counterholding, fine rotary adjustment, locking, and dynamic-response evaluation. pr-1694 uses sustained bimanual rolling-pin leveling and repeated translational strokes over deformable material.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks impact energy/velocity, damper stroke, hard-stop avoidance, rebound/overload, and setting retention. pr-1694 checks sheet length, thickness coverage, end damage, tool release/placement, and arm return. Candidate does not numerically define rebound, overload, drift, or tightening torque.
comparison.reason: The manipulation topology and measured physical outcome are materially different; repeated bimanual motion and damage avoidance do not establish overlap.
